pages.text: A tier 3 armor material from Ice and Fire. Use Shiny Scales or any color of Sea Serpent Scales directly in the Part Builder. Each scale provides 1 material unit. The seven parts are four armor platings, maille, shield plating and a shield core.

Durability / armor: helmet 330/4, chestplate 480/7, leggings 450/8, boots 390/4. Each armor plating has 2.5 toughness. Shield plating has 500 durability and 5 toughness. All five platings give 10% knockback resistance (0.1). Maille and shield cores have no extra stats.

Use 3 scales to make shield plating in the Part Builder. Combine it with any valid shield core at a Tinker Station to build a plate shield. Each Sea Beast Scales part grants 1 level of $(l:trait_tidal_shelter)Tidal Shelter$().
